newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Ascend LEAPS on April 14.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Ascend LEAPS on April 14.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Thursday it would list long-term equity anticipation securities (LEAPS) on shares of Ascend Communications Inc on April 14.
The AMEX said Ascend LEAPS would open with strike prices of 30, 45 and 60 and expirations in January 1998 and January 1999. GHM Inc has been named the specialist unit.
Regular options on Ascend shares trade on the AMEX, the Chicago Board Options Exchange, the Philadelphia Stock Exchange and the Pacific Exchange.
